mockBlueprints.topFindingHeadline: Your Firm Possesses Strong Capital Demand But Operates on Fragile Tribal Memory
mockBlueprints.executiveSummary: Deal progress currently depends entirely on personal memory, manual follow-ups, and unstandardized email documents.
